title: Getting Your Bearings
description: Learn how to begin life in town.
completion_text: The Adventurers' Guild offers training and contracts, and the town uses coins instead of emeralds.

stages.title: The Church
stages.lead: Ask the Pope where a newcomer should start.
notes: The Pope witnessed your summoning, but did not cause it.

objectives.description: Ask the Pope where to begin.

stages.title: Making a Living
stages.lead: Ask the Pope how trading works in town.
notes: The town uses coins rather than emeralds.
Contracts and trade can help pay for supplies.

objectives.description: Ask the Pope about coins and trading.
